integrity: Proof and reproducible source provided; numerical checks are finite corroboration, not external certification or independent mathematical review.
scientific_limitations: Finite simple trees with at least four vertices, synchronous binary open-neighborhood NOR only. The general F^3=F property and known maximal-independent-set fixed-state identification are prior work. The tree-specific basin census and sharp extremizers are asserted subject to possible unindexed or inaccessible precedent. Exhaustive finite checks cannot prove all-order claims.
title: Exact NOR attraction basins on complements of trees and sharp extremizers
